name: Shinjuku Ihen
source:
You have a part-time job taking photos of anomalies in the night in Shinjuku.

There are four rules for your part-time job.

If you see a anomaly, take a picture of it.

When taking a picture, get close to a anomaly to an appropriate distance.

However, don't get too close.

If you run out of film, come back.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3386350/Shinjuku_Anomaly/]Steam[/url]]
